the-dying-tree.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree.text: Welcome Traveller. I am King Narnode. It's nice to see an outsider.

the-dying-tree.player: Hi! It seems to be a busy settlement.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Traveller, can I speak to you in strictest confidence?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Not here, follow me.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Down here.
The player follows King Narnode down the trapdoor.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Enjoy your stay with us. There are many things to see in my kingdom.

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.text: These, my friend, are the foundations of the stronghold.

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.player: They look like roots to me.

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.text: Not just any roots Traveller! These were created by gnome mages eons ago, since then they have grown to become a mighty stronghold!

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.player: Impressive. What exactly is the problem?

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.text: In the last two months our tree guardians have reported continuing deterioration of the Grand Tree's health. I've never seen this before! It could be the end for us all!

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.player: You mean the tree is ill?

the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-foundations-cutscene.text: In effect yes. Would you be willing to help us discover what is happening to the tree?
If the player is below level 50 combat:

steps.text: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Thank Guthix for your arrival!

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: The first task is to find out what's killing the tree.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: My top tree guardian, Glough, believes it's human sabotage. I'm not so sure! The only way to know for sure is to talk to Hazelmere.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Hazelmere is one of the mages that created the Grand Tree! He is the only one that has survived from that time. Take this bark sample to him, he will be able to help!
The king shows you a sample of bark.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: The mage only talks in the old tongue, you'll need this.
The king shows you a translation book.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: It's a translation book, you'll need it to translate what Hazelmere says. Do that carefully! His words are our only hope! You'll find his dwellings high upon a towering hill, on an island east of Yanille.
The king hands you the bark sample and the translation book.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I'll show you the way back up.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Up here.
The player follows King Narnode back up the trapdoor.

steps.player: I'm sorry, I don't want to get involved.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I understand Traveller. Please keep this to yourself.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I'll show you the way back up.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Up here.
The player follows King Narnode back up the trapdoor.

the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.text: If the player has lost the bark sample:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here's another sample, hang on to it this time!
The King gives you another bark sample.

the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.text: If the player has lost the translation book:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Don't worry, I have more.
The King gives you another translation book.

the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.text: Hazelmere lives on an island just south of the Khazard Fight Arena. Give him the sample and translate his reply.

the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
the-dying-tree-when-speaking-to-king-nar.text: I just hope he can help us in our hour of need!

hazelmere-s-island.text: The mage starts to speak but all you hear is:
You give the bark sample to Hazelmere.
The mage carefully examines the sample.

hazelmere-s-island.player: Can you write this down and I'll try and translate it?

hazelmere-s-island.text: You make a writing motion. The mage scribbles something down on a scroll.
Hazelmere has given you the scroll.

hazelmere-s-island-when-speaking-again-t.text: You still can't understand Hazelmere. The mage wrote it down for you on a scroll.

a-deadly-plot-bring-back-the-news.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
a-deadly-plot-bring-back-the-news.text: Hello Traveller, did you speak to Hazelmere?

a-deadly-plot-bring-back-the-news.player: Yes! I managed to find him.

a-deadly-plot-bring-back-the-news.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
a-deadly-plot-bring-back-the-news.text: Do you understand what he said?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: So what did he say?

options.text: King Narnode must be stopped, he is a madman!

steps.player: King Narnode must be stopped, he is a madman!

options.text: Praise be to the great Zamorak!

steps.player: Praise be to the great Zamorak!

options.text: Do you have any bread? I do like bread.

steps.player: Do you have any bread? I do like bread.

options.text: The time has come to attack!

steps.player: The time has come to attack!

options.text: The tree is fine, you have nothing to fear.

steps.player: The tree is fine, you have nothing to fear.

options.text: You must come and see me!

steps.player: You must come and see me!

options.text: The tree needs watering as there has been drought.

steps.player: The tree needs watering as there has been drought.

options.text: Grave danger lies ahead, only the bravest will linger.

steps.player: Grave danger lies ahead, only the bravest will linger.

options.text: Time is of the essence! We must move quickly.

steps.player: Time is of the essence! We must move quickly.

options.text: A man came to me with the King's seal.
options.condition: If the player chose the previous options correctly:

steps.player: A man came to me with the King's seal.

options.text: There is no need for haste, just send a runner.

steps.player: There is no need for haste.

options.text: You must act now, or we will all die!

steps.player: You must act now or we will all die!

options.condition: If the player chose the previous options incorrectly:

options.text: I gave the man Daconia rocks.
options.condition: If the player chose the previous options correctly:

steps.player: I gave the man Daconia rocks.

options.text: Use a bucket of milk from a scared cow.

steps.player: Use a bucket of milk from a sacred cow.

options.text: Take this banana to him, he will understand.

steps.player: Take this banana to him, he will understand.

options.condition: If the player chose the previous options incorrectly:

options.text: All with be fine on the third night.

steps.player: All with be fine on the third night.

options.text: You must wait till the second night.

steps.player: You must wait till the second night.

options.text: The tree will die in five days!
options.condition: If the player chose the previous options incorrectly:

steps.player: The tree will die in five days!

options.text: And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!
options.condition: If the player chose the previous options correctly:

steps.player: And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!

steps.text: If the player chose the correct options:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Of course! I should've known! Someone must've forged my royal seal. Hazelmere thought I sent him for the Daconia stones!

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Hazelmere created the Daconia stones. They are a safety measure, in case the tree grew out of control. They're the only thing that can kill the tree.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: This is terrible! The stones must be recovered!

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: First I must warn the tree guardians. Please, could you tell the chief tree guardian Glough. He lives in a tree house just in front of the Grand Tree.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: If he's not there he will be at his girlfriend Anita's place. Meet me back here once you've told him.
If the player chose the wrong options:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Wait a minute! That doesn't sound like Hazelmere! Are you sure you translated correctly?

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: I'm sorry Traveller but this is no good. The translation must be perfect or the information's no use. Please come back when you know exactly what Hazelmere said.

options.text: No, I need to go back.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here's another sample, hang on to it this time!
Bark sample

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Time is of the essence Traveller!

a-deadly-plot-when-speaking-to-king-narn.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
a-deadly-plot-when-speaking-to-king-narn.text: Hello Traveller, did you speak to Glough?

a-deadly-plot-when-speaking-to-king-narn.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
a-deadly-plot-when-speaking-to-king-narn.text: OK. He lives just in front of the Grand Tree. Let me know when you've talked to him.

human-sabotage-glough.text: The gnome is munching on a worm hole.

human-sabotage-glough.speaker: Glough
human-sabotage-glough.text: Can I help human? Can't you see I'm eating?!

human-sabotage-glough.player: The King asked me to inform you that the Daconia rocks have been taken!
Apparently a human took them from Hazelmere. Hazelmere believed him; he had the King's seal!

human-sabotage-glough.speaker: Glough
human-sabotage-glough.text: I should've known! The humans are going to invade!

human-sabotage-glough.speaker: Glough
human-sabotage-glough.text: Your type can't be trusted! I'll take care of this! Go back to the King.

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.player: Hello, your highness. Have you any news on the Daconia stones?

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.text: It's OK Traveller, thanks to Glough! He found a human sneaking around! He had three Daconia rocks on him!

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.text: Yes Glough really knows what he's doing. The human has been detained until we know who else is involved.

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.text: Maybe Glough was right, maybe humans are invading!

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.player: I doubt it, can I speak to the prisoner?

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king.text: Certainly. He's on the top level of the tree. Be careful, it's a long way down!

human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king-whe.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-to-the-king-whe.text: Hello Traveller. If you wish to talk to the prisoner go to the top of the tree, you'll find him there.

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.player: Tell me. Why would you want to kill the Grand Tree?
Don't tell me, you just happened to be caught carrying Daconia rocks!

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: All I know is that I did what I was asked.

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: Glough paid me to go to this gnome on a hill. I gave the gnome a seal and he gave me some rocks to give to Glough.

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: I've been doing it for weeks, this time though Glough locked me up here! I just don't understand it.

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.player: Sounds like Glough is hiding something!

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: I don't know what he's up to. If you want to find out you'd better search his home.

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: Hello adventurer. Have you figured out what's going on?

human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.speaker: Charlie
human-sabotage-interrogating-the-prisone.text: To get to the bottom of this you'll need to search Glough's home.

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: Hello Traveller. So, did you speak to the culprit?

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.player: Yes I did and something's not right!
The prisoner said he was paid by Glough to get the Daconia stones!

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: That's absurd! He's just trying to save himself!

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: Since Glough's wife died he's been a little strange. He would never wrongly imprison someone though! Now that the culprit is locked up we can relax. It's sad but I think Glough was right.

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: Humans are planning to invade and wipe out the tree gnomes!

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: Who knows? You may have to leave soon Traveller! I trust you but the local gnomes are getting paranoid.

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.player: Your highness! I'm concerned about Glough!

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: Why? Don't worry about him now the culprit has been caught. I'm sure Glough's resentment of humans will pass with time.

human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
human-sabotage-reporting-back-to-king-na.text: If you're really concerned speak to him.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.player: Glough! I don't know what you're up to but I know you paid Charlie to get those rocks!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.speaker: Glough
searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.text: You're a fool human! You have no idea what's going on.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.player: I know the Grand Tree's dying! And I think you're part of the reason.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.speaker: Glough
searching-glough-s-cupboard-suspicions.text: How dare you accuse me! I'm the head tree guardian!
You are escorted by the guards and get locked up with Charlie

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: Charlie
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: So they got you as well?

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.player: It's Glough! He's trying to cover something up.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: Charlie
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: I shouldn't tell you this adventurer. But if you want to get to the bottom of this you should go and talk to the Karamja Shipyard foreman.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: Charlie
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: Glough sent me to Karamja to meet him. I delivered a large amount of gold. For what? I don't know. He may be able to tell you what Glough's up to. That's if you can get out of here. You'll find him

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: Charlie
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: in the Karamja Shipyard, east of Shilo Village. Be careful! If he discovers you're not working for Glough, there'll be trouble! The sea men use the password Ka-Lu-Min.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: Traveller please accept my apologies! Glough had no right to arrest you! I just think he's scared of humans. Let me get you out of there.
The player is let out of the cell.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.player: I don't think you can trust Glough, your highness. He seems to have an unnatural hatred for humans.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: I know he can be a bit extreme at times. But he's the best tree guardian I have, he has made the gnomes paranoid about humans though.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned.text: I'm afraid Glough has placed guards on the front gate to stop you escaping! Let my glider pilot fly you away until things calm down around here.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-w.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-w.text: Glough is looking for you! Leave on the glider now before it's too late!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-w.player: I can't figure this out Charlie!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-w.speaker: Charlie
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-w.text: Go and see the foreman in the Karamja jungle, there's a shipyard there, you might find some clues. Don't forget the password is Ka-Lu-Min; if they realise that you're not working for Glough there'll be trouble!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.speaker: Gnome guard
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.text: By order of the head tree guardian! You can not leave!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.speaker: Gnome guard
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.text: Humans are planning to attack our stronghold. You could be a spy!

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.speaker: Gnome guard
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-a.text: Maybe, but that's the orders, I'm sorry.

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-f.speaker: Captain Errdo
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-f.text: Hi, the King said that you need to leave?

searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-f.speaker: Captain Errdo
searching-glough-s-cupboard-imprisoned-f.text: I find that hard to believe! I have lots of human friends.

steps.speaker: Captain Errdo
steps.text: Okay, you're the boss! Hold on tight, it'll be a rough ride.
You fly on the glider.

steps.speaker: Captain Errdo
steps.text: Okay. I'll be here for when you're ready.

treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.speaker: Captain Errdo
treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.text: That turbulence over the Karamja Volcano was a bit unexpected, and the area round here isn't well suited for emergency landing.

treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.speaker: Captain Errdo
treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.text: Still! we're still alive that's the main thing. Are you okay?

treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.player: I'm fine, I can't say the same for your glider!

treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.speaker: Captain Errdo
treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.text: I don't think I can fix this. Looks like we'll be heading back by foot. I might see if I can find Penwie while I'm here, I believe he's charting the area.

treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.speaker: Captain Errdo
treachery-revealed-arrival-landing-crash.text: I think I saw some buildings on the coast east of here while we were crashing. I'd have a look there.

treachery-revealed-arrival-talking-to-ca.speaker: Captain Errdo
treachery-revealed-arrival-talking-to-ca.text: It's east of here. I think I saw some buildings on the coast while we were crashing...

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-password.speaker: Shipyard worker
treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-password.text: Hey you! What are you up to?

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-password.player: I'm trying to open the gate!

options.text: I'm from the Ministry of Health and Safety.

steps.player: I'm from the Ministry of Health and Safety.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Never 'erd of 'em.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Get out of here before I give you a beating!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Hmm...really? What for?

steps.player: You're wasting my time! Take me to your superior!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: OK. Password.
If the player chose Ka-Lu-Min:

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Sorry to have kept you.
The player goes through the gate.
If the player chose any other options:

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: You have no idea!
The player is attacked by the Shipyard worker.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: This ain't a museum! Leave now!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Well you're not on the list so you're not coming in. Go away.

steps.player: Well I'll just stand here then until you let me in.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: You do that!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Yeah?

steps.player: So are you going to let me in then?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: No.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: No. I can stand here all day.

steps.player: Alright you win. I'll find another way in.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: No you won't.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: I'm not starting that again. Maybe if I ignore you you'll go away...

steps.player: Quite a few ships you're building!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: This is just the start! The completed fleet will be awesome!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: No time to talk we've a fleet to build!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Hello matey!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Tired!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: It needs to be. There's no other way to build a fleet of this size!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Hello there. I haven't seen you before.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Well it's hard work, but the pay is good.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Too busy to waste time gossiping!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: I like to keep busy.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Hello there, are you too lazy to work as well?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: I'm just sun bathing!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: No time to talk we've a fleet to build!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Are you serious?

steps.player: Of course not! You're obviously building a boat.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: I'm getting tired of this!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Breaking my back for pennies! It's just not on!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.player: Is that any way to talk to your new superior?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't realise!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: I cut my finger!

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Do you have a bandage?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: That's ok, I'll use my shirt.

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Can I help you?

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Well there's plenty of work to be done, so if you don't mind...

steps.speaker: Shipyard worker
steps.text: Of course. Sorry to have disturbed you.

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.player: Glough sent me to check on how you are doing.

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.speaker: Foreman
treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.text: Hmm...in that case we'd better go to my office. Follow me.
You follow the Foreman to his office

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.speaker: Foreman
treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.text: Tell me again why you're here.

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.speaker: Foreman
treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-foreman.text: By the way how is Glough? Still with his wife?

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Really? That's odd, considering she died last year. Die imposter!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Really? That's odd, considering she died last year. Die imposter!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

options.text: Sadly his wife is no longer with us!

steps.player: Sadly his wife is no longer with us!

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Right answer. I have to watch for imposters. What's Glough's favourite dish?

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Our survey said.... Bzzzzzz! Wrong answer!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: OK. Just one more. What's the name of his new girlfriend?

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Well, well, you do know Glough. Sorry for the interrogation but I'm sure you understand.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: As you can see things are going well.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: When I was asked to build a fleet large enough to invade Port Sarim and carry 300 gnome troops I said: 'If anyone can, I can.'

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: True but if the gnomes are really going to take over Gielinor they'll need at least that.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Of course, why else would Glough want 30 battleships? Between you and me I don't think he stands a chance.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: I mean, for the kind of battleships Glough's ordered I'll need tons and tons of lumber! Still, if he says he can supply the wood I'm sure he can! Anyway, here's the order for the lumber.
The foreman has given you the lumber order.
Lumber order

steps.player: OK. I'll head off and give this order to Glough.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: You almost had me fooled! Die imposter!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: You almost had me fooled! Die imposter!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

steps.speaker: Foreman
steps.text: Our survey said.... Bzzzzzz! Wrong answer!
The player is attacked by the Foreman.

treachery-revealed-the-shipyard-talking-.text: The foreman is too busy to talk.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.speaker: Gnome guard
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.text: I'm afraid that we have orders not to let you in.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.speaker: Gnome guard
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.text: The head tree guardian, he say's you're a spy!

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.speaker: Gnome guard
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-gnome.text: I'm sorry but you'll have to leave.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.player: I can't believe they won't let me in!

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: I don't believe all this rubbish about an invasion. If mankind wanted to, they could have invaded before now.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.player: I really need to see King Narnode. Could you help sneak me in?

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: Well, as you helped me I suppose I could. We'll have to be careful. If I get caught I'll be in the cage!

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: Jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine
Femi sneaks the player inside the stronghold.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: Okay, traveller, you'd better get going.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: Why should I help you, you wouldn't help me!

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.player: Erm I know, but this is an emergency!

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: So was lifting that barrel! Tell you what, call it a round 1000 gold pieces.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: That's right, 1000 and I'll sneak you in.

steps.text: You give Femi 1000 coins.

steps.speaker: Femi
steps.text: Alright, jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
Femi sneaks the Player inside the stronghold

steps.speaker: Femi
steps.text: Okay, traveller, you'd better get going.

steps.speaker: Femi
steps.text: That's okay, all the best.

treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.speaker: Femi
treachery-revealed-sneaking-around-when-.text: Now, to get this lot to the Grand Tree!

steps.speaker: Femi
steps.text: No, you're okay, traveller. I can manage from here.

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.player: I know what you're up to Glough!
You may be able to make a fleet but the tree gnomes will never follow you into battle against humans.

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.text: So, you know more than I thought! The gnomes fear humanity more than any other race. I just need to give them a push in the right direction. There's nothing you can do traveller! Leave before it's too late!

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.text: The King's a fool and a coward! He'll bow to me! You'll soon be back in that cage!

treachery-revealed-king-narnode.player: King Narnode, I need to talk!

treachery-revealed-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-king-narnode.text: Traveller, what are you doing here? The stronghold has been put on full alert! It's not safe for you here!

treachery-revealed-king-narnode.player: Your highness, I believe Glough is killing the trees in order to make a mass fleet of warships!
His hatred for humanity is stronger than you know!

treachery-revealed-king-narnode.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-king-narnode.text: That's enough Traveller, you sound as paranoid as him! Traveller please leave! It's bad enough having one human locked up.

treachery-revealed-charlie.player: Glough has some plan to rule Gielinor!

treachery-revealed-charlie.speaker: Charlie
treachery-revealed-charlie.text: I wouldn't put it past him, the Gnome's crazy!

treachery-revealed-charlie.player: I need some proof to convince the King.

treachery-revealed-charlie.speaker: Charlie
treachery-revealed-charlie.text: Hmm... you could be in luck! Before Glough had me locked up I heard him mention that he'd left his chest key at his girlfriend's house. She lives just west of the toad swamp.

treachery-revealed-charlie.player: Okay, I'll see what I can find.

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.text: Please Traveller, if the gnomes see me talking to you they'll revolt against me.

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.text: Glough's scared the whole town, he expects the humans to attack any day. He's even begun to recruit hundreds of gnome soldiers.

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.player: Don't you understand he's creating his own army?!

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-king.text: Please Traveller, leave before it's too late!

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.player: I'm going to stop you, Glough!

treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-when-speaking-to-glou.text: Leave human, before I have you put in the cage!

treachery-revealed-anita.speaker: Anita
treachery-revealed-anita.text: Oh hello, I've seen you with the King.

treachery-revealed-anita.player: Yes, I'm helping him with a problem.

treachery-revealed-anita.speaker: Anita
treachery-revealed-anita.text: You must know my boyfriend Glough then?

treachery-revealed-anita.speaker: Anita
treachery-revealed-anita.text: Could you do me a favour?

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Please give this key to Glough, he left it here last night.
Anita gives you a key.
Glough's key

steps.speaker: Anita
steps.text: Thanks a lot.

treachery-revealed-anita-talking-to-anit.speaker: Anita
treachery-revealed-anita-talking-to-anit.text: Have you taken that key to Glough yet?

treachery-revealed-anita-talking-to-anit.player: No, I'm still carrying it around.

treachery-revealed-anita-talking-to-anit.speaker: Anita
treachery-revealed-anita-talking-to-anit.text: Oh. Please take it to Glough!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.player: You were right! I searched Glough's chest and found some invasion plans!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: Charlie
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: Go to the king and tell him! Finally you have proof. Surely King Narnode will believe you now and set me free!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.player: Hi, your highness, did you think about what I said?

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: Look, if you're right about Glough I would have him arrested but there's no reason for me to think he's lying.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.player: Look, I found this at Glough's home!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: You give the King the invasion plans.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: If these are to be believed then this is terrible!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: But it's not proof, any one could have made these. Traveller, I understand your concern, I had guards search Glough's house but they found nothing suspicious, just these odd twigs.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: On the other hand, if Glough's right about the humans we will need an army of gnomes to protect ourselves. So I've decided to allow Glough to raise a mighty gnome army.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-talkin.text: The Grand Tree's still slowly dying, if it is human sabotage we must respond!
The King has given you some twigs lashed together.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-when-s.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-when-s.text: Please Traveller, take my advice and leave!
If the player has lost the twigs:

steps.player: I've lost those twigs you gave me.

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Here take these, I don't see how it will help you though.
If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
steps.text: Hmm. Looks like you can't carry anymore. Put 4 things down and come back to me.
If the player has enough inventory space:
The King has given you some twigs lashed together.
4 Twigs

treachery-revealed-glough-s-plans-when-s.text: The prisoner is in no mood to talk.

treachery-revealed-the-mystery-of-the-tw.text: You cannot put that on the pillar.
With a grinding of machinery, a trapdoor snaps open!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet.text: You really are becoming a headache! Well, at least now you can die knowing you were right, it will save me having to hunt you down like all the other human filth of Gielinor!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet.text: Bah! Well, soon you'll see, the gnomes are ready to fight, in three weeks this tree will be dead wood, in ten weeks it will be 30 battleships! Finally we will rid the world of the disease called humanity!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet.player: What makes you think I'll let you get away with it?

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-cli.speaker: Glough
treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-cli.text: Pay attention when I'm talking to you!
The player is moved back to the platform.

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.player: Your highness, it's true about Glough I tell you! He's planning to take over Gielinor!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.text: I'm sorry Traveller but it's just not realistic. How could Glough, even with a gnome army, take over?

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.player: He plans to make a fleet of warships from the Grand Tree's wood!

treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
treachery-revealed-glough-s-pet-when-tal.text: That's enough Traveller! I've no time for make believe. The tree's still dying. I must get to the truth of this!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.player: It's Glough! He set a demon on me!
Glough has a store of Daconia rocks further up the passage! He's been accessing the roots from a secret passage at his home.

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: Never! Not Glough! He's a good gnome at heart!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: Go and check out that passage!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: Gnome guard
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: We found Glough hiding under a horde of Daconia rocks!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.player: That's what I've been trying to tell you! Glough's been fooling you!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: I..I don't know what to say! How could I have been so blind?!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: Guard! Call off the military training!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: You have my full apologies Traveller! And my gratitude!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel.text: A reward will have to wait though, the tree is still dying! The guards are clearing Glough's rock supply now but there must be more Daconia hidden somewhere in the roots! Help us search, we have little time!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.text: Traveller, have you managed to find the Daconia?

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.player: No sign of it so far.

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.text: The tree will still die if we don't find it! It could be anywhere!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-wh.player: Don't worry your highness! We'll find it!

saving-the-tree-the-end-of-the-tunnel-se.text: You search the root but don't find anything.

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: Traveller, have you managed to find the Daconia?
You give the King the Daconia rock.

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: It's incredible, the tree's health is improving already! I don't know what to say, we owe you so much!

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: To think Glough had me fooled all along!

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.player: All that matters now is that humans and gnomes can live together in peace!

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: From now on I vow to make this stronghold a welcoming place for all! I'll grant you access to all our facilities.

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: It should make your stay here easier. You can use the spirit tree to transport yourself, as well as the gnome glider. I also give you access to our mine.

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: Very few know of the secret mine under the Grand Tree. If you push on the roots just to my north they will seperate and let you pass.

saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.speaker: King Narnode Shareen
saving-the-tree-daconia-delivered.text: All the best Traveller and thanks again!

post-quest-glough.speaker: Glough
post-quest-glough.text: I warn you now, human: stay out of my affairs!

post-quest-glough.player: I've stopped you before, Glough, and I'll stop you again!
